tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod bdag 'jug gi cho ga mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i nye lam gyi lhan thabs dkyus su bcug pa nag 'gros bklag chog gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /oṃ bde legs su gyur cig

rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba'i cho ga mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i nye lam zhes bya ba tshar chen rdo rje 'chang chen po'i gsung ji lta ba bzhin la mchod phreng rgyas pa dang tshogs mchod kha bskang bsnan pa'i nag po 'gro shes bklag chog gsal ba'i me long bkod pa la/ bla ma dang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dbyer med pa'i zhabs la gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal lo// de la 'dir 'khor lo bde mchog rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing*/ dam tshig dang sdom pa ldan pas/ rje btsun ma 'di nyid kyi sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du byin rlabs legs par thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa dag gis tshes bcu rnam pa gnyis la sogs pa dus khyad par can gyi tshe/ rje btsun ma 'di nyid kyi sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang bar 'dod pas rang nyid kyi sgrub khang la sogs pa dben zhing yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su chag chag dang byi dor la sogs pa legs par byas/ bla ma dang rje btsun ma'i bris sku dang*/ 'bur sku la sogs pa'i rten yod na tshul bzhin bshams pa'i drung du mthas shing ngos snyoms pa'i sa gzhi 'am/ stegs bu la sogs pa ba byung lnga dang dri bzang gis chus byug khru gang la sogs pa'i tshad kyis zlum bskor bya/ de'i phyi rol du sor phyed tsam bskyed pa'i zlum bskor gnyis pa bya/ nang gi zlum skor dang mthun par chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi thig gdab/ de la tshon dbye ba ni/ chos 'byung gnyis dmar po thig nas gcod mtshams re khā dkar/ nang gi zlum skor dang chos 'byung gi bar gyi khyams ljang khu/ mu khyud sdon po/ mu khyud kyi phyi nang gnyis ka'i re khā dkar po/ chos 'byung gnyis kyi dbus su zla gdan gyi steng du tshom bu dmar po bkod pa ni sku tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba yin la/

'di nyid 'jug pa bde bar 'dod pas ras sam dar dmar po la bris kyang rung zhes gsung*/ de'i steng du mañdzi la sogs par thod pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i nang du/ chang la sbrang ngam bu ram la sogs pa sbyar/ bdud rtsi ril bu'am phye ma btab la dpral ba rang nyid la phyogs par bzhag de ni gsung bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba yin/ de'i khar shing bu phra mos rgya gram byas la dar dmar gyis bkab/ de'i steng du me long ngam ma 'byor na shing leb la sogs pa'i khar sindhu ra tshags la btsag pa khod snyoms par bkram/ gser gyi thur ma'am med na rdo rje'i rtse mos chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi dbus su rgya yig gam bod yig gang rung gi bam̐ yig bris pa'i mthar mdun nas g.yon bskor gyis oṃ gsum ma'i sngags phreng mgo phyir bstan 'khor yug tu bris/ de yang oṃ gsum/ de'i rjes su sarba dang*/ buddha dang*/ ḍā ki dang*/ nī ye dang*/ badzra dang*/ warṇa dang*/ ni ye dang*/ badzra dang*/ bai ro dang*/ tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ gsum/ phaṭa gsum/ swā hā rnams rim bzhin bri ba ma gtogs 'bru re nas bzlog pa ni mi mdzad/ de'ang shar drang por/ oṃ dang*/ byang du ḍā dang nub tu nī dang*/ lhor hūm̐ gsum pa bris na cha snyoms par 'byung ngo*/ mdun rgyab gnyis spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa bri'o// de ni thugs sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba yin no// de rnams kyi steng du dar dmar ram/ ling dmar ram ras dmar gang yang rung bas gur khang legs par phub/ zan gtsang ma'i ril bu chung ngu la ras dkar gyi sdong bu btsugs pa 'bri mog gi mar khu'i kha dog bsgyur ba sindhu ra'i maṇḍal gyi steng ngam mdun phyogs gang rung ngu bzhag sgrub mchod rkyang pa'i dus ma bshams kyang rung*/ de'i mtha' bskor du chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga phyogs mtshams re rer bkod pa g.yon bskor du bshams/

dku bag can gyi gtor ma lnga tshar ram/ bsdu na gsum du byas pa maṇḍal gyi mdun nam/ rgyab phyogs gang bder bsham/ slob dpon gyi mdun du bum pa bcud dang ldan pa mgul chings dmar po/ kha rgyan dung chos rdor gzungs rnams tshang ba dang*/ rdo rje dril bu nang mchod me tog dang bcas pa/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i yo byad rnams ma tshang ba med pa bshams/ de dag ni cho gar ma gtogs pa'i sbyor ba'o// cho gar gtogs pa'i sbyor ba la/ thog mar brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs ni/ ༈ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i rigs bdag rdo rje chos// rgyal ba'i yum mchog rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// rgyal sras thu bo nā ro ta pa'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// gsang chen slob bshad 'dzin pa'i pham thing pa// gsang mdzod kun gyi gter gyur shes rab brtsegs// gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag mal lo'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// rdo rje 'chang chen bla chen sa skya pa// rdo rje'i sras mchog rje btsun bsod nams rtse// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gtsug rgyan grags pa'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// sa skya paṇa chen gangs can mkhas pa'i rje// sa gsum skye rgu'i gtsug rgyan 'phags pa'i mchog /sa skya'i bstan 'dzin zhang ston chos rje'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// grub pa'i dbang po na bza' brag phug pa// grub mchog mkhas pa'i ded dpon chos kyi rje// sgrub rigs snyan brgyud mnga' bdag yar klung pa// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// bdag gzhan 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon rgyal ba mchog /bdag nyid chen po 'jam dbyangs nam mkha'i mtshan// bdag chen chos rje blo gros rgyal mtshan zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// bka' drin mnyam med rje btsun rdo rings pa// bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i bstan 'dzin blo gsal dbang*// bka' brgyud gsang chen smra ba mkhyen brtse'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol/

(/sku gsum rgyal ba'i ngo bo rdo rje 'chang*// sku bzhi'i 'bras stsol gnyan ston sprul pa'i gar// sku drin mtshungs med gzhon nu blo gros zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol/) /rig sngags 'chang ba bslab gsum rgyal mtshan dang*// rigs brgya'i khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan dpal// rigs kyi gtso bo rje btsun bka' 'gyur ba// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag zhwa lu ba// dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso bo mkhyen rab rje// dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i bdag po rnam gnyis la// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// snyan brgyud rgya mtsho'i ded dpon rdo rje 'dzin// snyan brgyud mnga' bdag rmor chen rdo rje 'chang*// snyan brgyud spel mkhas legs pa'i 'byung gnas la// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// rigs brgya'i khyab bdag kun dga' blo gros dang*// rig 'dzin chen po bstan 'dzin lhun grub zhabs// rig gnas mthar son blo gsal phun tshogs la// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// rnam mkhyen bla ma bzhi yi thugs kyi sras// rnam mang 'gro la brtse ba'i lhag bsam can// rnam 'dren 'khor lo'i mgon po mkhyen rab rje// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// zab gsang snyan brgyud gdams pa ma lus pa'i// zab don mdzod 'dzin gzim 'og rdo rje 'chang*// zab lam mnga' bdag rig 'dzin maṅga'i mtshan// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin de bzhin nyid// dngos su gzigs pa'i dpal ldan gu ṇa pa// dngos grub mchog stsol rje btsun ya sha'i mtshan// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// rnam mang ma gyur 'gro ba'i mgon gcig pu// rnam 'dren grub pa'i dbang phyug pradzñā'i mtshan// rnam gsum 'dus zhal rje btsun nā ga'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// bstan pa'i mnga' bdag 'khon rigs sa skya pa'i// bstan 'dzin dam pa lce btsun mkhyen brtse'i dbang*// bstan pa'i gsal byed kun dga'i mtshan can la// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// gsang chen rgyud sde'i mthar thug gsang mtha'i bcud// gsang sngags zab mo'i nye lam gdams pa'i mchog

/gsang mdzod ston mkhas rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol/ (/rab 'byams rgyal ba'i bstan pa mtha' dag la// rab grol snyan brgyud 'dzin mkhas chos kyi rje// rab mchog drin chen nam mkha'i mtshan can la// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol/) ༈ dal 'byor gru chen mi rtag dran pa yi// ba dan dkar pos bskyod pa'i las 'bras kyi// blang dor mthun pa'i rlung gis rab bskul nas// 'jigs rung 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgrol bar shog /bslu med skyabs gnas gtsug gi nor bur bsten// mar gyur 'gro ba'i don chen snying la zhugs// rdor sems bdud rtsis nyes pa'i dri ma bkrus// rje btsun bla ma'i thugs rjes skyong bar shog /yid 'ong rgyal yum phyi yi rnal 'byor ma// bam̐ yig nang gi rdo rje btsun mo mchog /sems nyid stong gsal gsang ba'i mkha' spyod yum// rang zhal mthong ba'i rtse dgas rol bar shog /snod kyi 'jig rten e yig gzhal med khang*// bcud kyi sems can bam̐ yig rnal 'byor ma// zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i ting 'dzin gyis// cir snang dag pa'i snang bar 'char bar shog /de ltar phyogs dang zla ba'i rnal 'byor gyis// nam zhig dus na dga' ma byi ru'i mdog /li khri'i skra grol dmar ser mig g.yo mas// mngon sum rig 'dzin grong du 'khrid par shog /sindhur laṅka li ya'i sdong bur bcas// ro ldan gnas su bsgrubs cing yul kun tu// nyul bas gang gi mdzod spur 'khyil ris can// 'phos ba'i mdzes mas mkha' spyod 'khrid par shog /nang gi phag mos gzung 'dzin 'khri shing bcom// mchog gi dhū tir zhugs pa'i gar mkhan ma// tshangs pa'i sgo nas sprin lam dbyings su thon// khrag 'thung dpa' bor 'khyud cing rol bar shog /lte ba'i padmor rlung lnga'i ti la ka /rtse gcig bsgoms pa'i kha sbyor rnal 'byor gyis// lus sems rtsa la dri gzhon zhugs pa yi// bde ba mchog gis bdag rgyud tshim par shog

/tha mar 'od kyi gtum mo mdzes ldan ma// dhū tir 'dzum dkar bzhad pa'i rol rtsed kyis// haṃ yig gzhon nu yongs su mnyes byas nas// zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i sa thob shog /skye 'gag gnas gsum bral ba gdod ma'i gshis// stong gsal brjod du med pa gnyug ma'i ngang*/ zung 'jug blo 'das rang sems rnal 'byor ma// rang ngo shes nas rtag tu skyong bar shog /rtsa rlung thig le e waṃ dbyings su thim// sems nyid bde chen chos sku'i dpal thob nas// bgrang yas gzugs sku'i rnam rol dpag med kyis// nam mkha'i mtha' klas 'gro 'di skyong bar shog / sngon 'gro gtor ma chu chang gis sbyangs la/ oṃ sumbha ni sumbha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhṇa pā ya gṛhṇa pā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya hoḥbha ga wān bidyā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmā swa bhā wa shuddho ྅haṃ/ gis sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ dang lag g.yas g.yon dbus gsum bstan pa dang bya khyung gi phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ slar yang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod/ de nas mkha' 'gro spyi gtor ni/ phaiṃ/ zhes dang*/ oṃ badzra ā ra lli hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badzra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya st+waṃ/ dṛ shya hoḥ zhes brjod/ rang gi snying kha'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis 'dzam bu'i gling na gdod nas grub pa'i dur khrod brgyad mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par bsam la/ de rnams la gtor ma 'bul bar bsam ste thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yakṣa rākṣa/ bhu ta pre ta pi shwa tsi unmad/ a pa sma ra/ ḍā ka ḍā ki n+yadā ya/ i maṃ ba liṃ gṛhṇantu/ sa ma ya rakṣantu/ ma ma sarba siddhiṃ/ me pra yatstshantu/ ya thai baṃ/ ya thai ṣṭaṃ/ bhuñdza tha/ dzi gha tha/ pi pa thā/ ma tī kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kārya sat+su khaṃ/ bi shuddha ye sa hā yi kā bhā wantu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/

zhes lan gsum gyis phul/ oṃ arghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ pa dyaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra dhūppe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra nai wi dya āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra shabda āḥhūm̐/ gis mchod/ nang mchod phul te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rin chen mkha' 'gro/ padma mkha' 'gro/ sna tshogs mkha' 'gro la sogs pa gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo// zhes brjod/ dril bu chig brdung bya zhing*/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// klu yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// 'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// sha za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// smyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// rjed byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// de la sogs te 'byung po'i tshogs// ma lus pa ni thams cad dag /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol// bstan pa bsrung dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir// thugs dam bcas shing zhal gyis bzhes pa rnams// dpal chen bka' stod yid ltar mgyogs pa yi// 'jigs pa'i gzugs can drag gtum mi bzad pa// gdug pa 'dul mdzad nag po'i tshogs rnams 'dzoms// rnal 'byor las la 'bras bu ster mdzad cing*// mthu stobs byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i// gnod sbyin tshogs sogs brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo// sde brgyad btsun mo sras dang g.yog bcas kyis// dngos grub kun gyi bka' drin bdag la stsol// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyi stongs grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*// dge legs thams cad 'byung ba dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog

/dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang*/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir du rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang bar 'tshal na/ dkar phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i srung ma khyad par can khyed rnams kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bar chad thams cad bsrung ba dang*/ de nas kyang bdag cag rnal 'byor 'khor dang bcas pa byang chub ma thob kyi bar gyi bar chad thams cad bsrung ba dang byang chub sgrub pa'i sdong grogs mdzad du gsol/ gang dag nag po'i phyogs su gyur pa gsang spyod blta bar mi dbang ba'i bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du songs shig oṃ sumbha ni sumbha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhṇa pā ya gṛhṇa pā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān bidyā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

lan gsum brjod cing rdo rje dril bu gsor dkrol drag tu bya/ gtor ma phyir sa gtsang sar dor ro// ༈ /gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ oṃ sumbha ni sumbha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhna pā ya gṛhṇa pā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān bidyā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ gis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bhrūm̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ rta babs bzhis mdzes pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams bzang zhing rgya che ba dwangs shing thogs pa med pa sa dang nam mkha' bar snang thams cad gang ba 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa bla ma dang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra pādyaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃbadzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra dhūppe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra nai wi dyāe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra shabda āḥhūm̐/ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dpral bar bcas la/ oṃ badzra spha ra ṇa khaṃ ces pas mang por spel/ oṃ badzra ghaṇḍe ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba buddha kṣe tra pra tsa li te pradzñā pā ra mi tā nā da saṃ bha wan/ badzra dharmā hri da ya ni santo ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho āḥkhaṃ swā hā/

zhes lan gsum brjod pas dang pos mchod yul rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ gnyis pas de dag gis gnas khang byin gyis brlab/ gsum pas mchod pa byin gyis brlab par bsams la rol chen bya/ de nas maṇḍal zhu 'bul spyi ltar bya ba ni/ oṃ badzra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi yongs su dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ oṃ badzra re khe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri khor yug gis bskor ba'i dbus su hūm̐/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling*/ nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ cho ga'i skabs dbye bar mdzad du gsol/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ he ru ka'i bsgom bzlas bde mchog ltar byas pas rgyud sbyangs/ bdag bskyed rjogs pa bzlas pa la thugs gi bar du sgrub thabs kyi ngag 'don ltar nyams su blangs/ zhes gsungs pas skyabs yul gsal btab la/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes lan gsum mam bdun sogs brjod/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes tshar gcig brjod/ bdag gis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byas la/

sems can thams cad srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las bsgral bar bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lam gyi rim pa zab mo nyams su blang bar bya'o// zhes lan gsum brjod/ rang gi spyi bor padma dang zla ba'i gdan la skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan cing zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rang 'dra'i rigs bdag gi dbu rgyan can/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i yab kyi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas hūm̐ la thim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad rtsa ba nas byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas hūm̐ las bdud rtsi babs/ yab kyi sku gang*/ rdo rje'i lam brgyud/ yum gyi padmar babs/ yum gyi sku gang*/ yab yum gnyis ka'i sku thams cad las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ bdag gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs pas las ngan sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu dang rnag khrag gi rnam pas bshang gci gnyis dang*/ rkang mthil gnyis nas 'thon/ shul thams cad bdud rtsi dkar pos khengs par gyur/ par bsam la/ oṃ shrī badzra he ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ he ru ka twe no pa tiṣṭha/ dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣyo me bha wa/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ su po ṣyo me bha wa/ sarba siddhimme pra yatstsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsittaṃ shri yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥbha ga wān badzra he ru ka

mā me muñtsa he ru ko bha wa/ mahā sa ma ya sa twa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ nyi shu rtsa gcig bzla/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste// dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi// sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so// sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad rtsa ba nas byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu/ rang la thim pas rang gi lus shel gong g.ya' dag pa lta bur gyur/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ ༈ /mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs padma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rje btsun rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas pas bde stong gi sgra sgrogs pa'i ḍā ma ru 'khrol ba/ g.yon pas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ gru mo g.yon na kha ṭwāṃ ga bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan cing gzhon nu lang tsho dar la babs pa skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gyur/ ces dang*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma 'od du zhu spyi bo nas rang la thim pas/ rang gi snying gar e e las chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bam̐ yig dmar po'i mthar g.yon bskor du/ om̐ om̐ om̐ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye badzra warṇa nī ye/ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags phreng kha dog dmar pos bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros lus thams cad gang*/

lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa ni/ sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma'i steng nas mnan pa/ g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po'i mgo bo rgyab tu bltabs nas mnan pa/ sku mdog dmar mo bskal pa'i me lta bu'i gzi brjid can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dag pa mkha' spyod du gzigs pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug thur du brkyangs nas 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba steng phyogs su bzung nas zhal gyen du phyogs pas gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yon par rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭwāṃ ga la ḍā ma ru dang dril bu dang*/ 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyang bzhin pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pas sku sked yan chad khebs pa/ lang tsho dar la bab cing 'dod pa'i nu 'bur rgyas pa/ bde ba skyed pa'i nyams can/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// de'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar ham̐ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang khu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇḍi kā'i ngo bor gyur/ snying ga'i sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros te ba spu'i bu ga nas phar song*/ rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la phog pas sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/ de thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral ba'i dbyings su g.yon bskor du lan gsum bskor zhing*/ ngag tu/ phaiṃ/

rang gi snying ga'i bam̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros/ 'og min nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis bskor ba dang 'gro ba rnal 'byor mar gyur pa thams cad kyang bdag nyid la thim par gyur/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pa dang*/ pad kor gyi mthar 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ yo ga shuddhaḥsarba dharmā yo ga shuddho ྅haṃ zhes brjod/ rang gi snying gar chos 'byung gru gsum dmar po nyis brtsegs kyi nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bam̐ yig la sngags phreng kha dog dmar pos g.yon du bskor ba las 'od zer dmar mo dpag tu med pa 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad mchod/ de rnams kyi byin rlabs nus mthu 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par spyan drangs/ sngags phreng la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ oṃ oṃ oṃ/ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye/ badzra warṇa nī ye/ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā'/ zhes brgya rtsa la sogs pa bzlas/ snying ga'i chos 'byung zla ba yig 'bru dang bcas pa bde ba bskyed par 'dod na gsang gnas dang*/ mi rtog pa bskyed par 'dod na lte bar phab ste/ mdun rgyab spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa re g.yon du 'khor ba dang*/ sngags phreng lan gsum mam bdun la sogs pa klog pa'i tshul du sems gtad nas rlung kha sbyor ci thub 'dzin/ rang gi smin mtshams dang gsang gnas su dga' 'khyil g.yon bskor du shugs drag tu 'khor ba la sems gtad nas rlung kha sbyor bzung*/ dga' 'khyil gnyis mthar snying ga'i bam̐ yig la thim par bsam mo// ༈ /de nas mdun gyi nang mchod dang mañdzi'i steng gi gsung bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor la dmigs te/ oṃ sumbha ni sumbha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhna pā ya gṛhṇa pā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān bidyā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhuḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho ྅haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ zhes pa'i phyag rgya bcas pa lan gsum brjod/ de nas dkyil 'khor gsum char la dmigs te/ oṃ sumbha ni sumbha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhna pā ya gṛhṇa pā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān bidyā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor/ wam̐ las chu'i dkyil 'khor/ lam̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor/ sum̐ las ri rab kyi steng du a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba bdud rtsi lngas yongs su gang ba'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug rdo rje'i rwa ba dang drwa ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ phyi rol thams cad mda'i drwa ba dang ye shes kyi me ri rab tu 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i nang du/ dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba'i dbus su e e las chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bam̐ yig dmar po'i mtha' bskor du/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye/ badzra warṇa nī ye/ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags phreng kha dog dmar pos bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/

tshur 'dus yig 'bru rnams la thim pa yongs su gyur pa las rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa ni sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma'i steng nas mnan pa/ g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po'i mgo bo rgyab tu bltabs nas mnan pa/ sku mdog dmar mo bskal pa'i me lta bu'i gzi brjid can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dag pa mkha' spyod du gzigs pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug thur du brkyangs nas 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba steng phyogs su bzung nas zhal gyen du phyogs pas gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yon par rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭwāṃ ga la ḍā ma ru dang dril bu dang 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyang bzhin pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pas sku sked yan chad khebs pa/ lang tsho dar la babs cing 'dod pa'i nu 'bur rgyas pa/ bde ba skyed pa'i nyams can/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// de nas 'bar ba'i phyag rgya smin mtshams su g.yon bskor du lan gsum bskor zhing ngag tu/

phaiṃ/ rang gi thugs ka'i bam̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'og min nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ pad kor gyi mthar 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ yo ga shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shuddho3haṃ/ de'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar ham̐ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇḍi kā'i ngo bor gyur/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni 'khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ slar yang thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rtsa ba'i bla ma rje btsun rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can la brgyud pa'i bla ma dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mchod pa'i yul du mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ mdun gyi mchod pa rnams/ oṃ sumbha ni sumbha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ gṛhna pā ya gṛhṇa pā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān bidyā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas shabda āḥhūm̐ bar brjod cing byin gyis rlabs la/ mchod pa 'bul ba ni thal mo sbyar te/ stong gsum 'di 'am stong gsum gzhan dag na// lha rdzas mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams// bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la 'bul// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha pu dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ stong gsum 'di 'am stong gsum gzhan dag na// lha rdzas zhabs bsil ji snyed yod pa rnams// bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la 'bul// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra pādyaṃ pra tītstsha pu dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ stong gsum 'di 'am stong gsum gzhan dag na// lha rdzas me tog ji snyed yod pa rnams// bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la 'bul// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra puṣpe pra tītstsha pu dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ stong gsum 'di 'am stong gsum gzhan dag na// lha rdzas bdug spos ji snyed yod pa rnams// bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la 'bul// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra dhū pe pra tītstsha pu dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/

stong gsum 'di 'am stong gsum gzhan dag na// lha rdzas snang gsal ji snyed yod pa rnams// bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la 'bul// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra ā lo ke pra tītstsha pu dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ stong gsum 'di 'am stong gsum gzhan dag na// lha rdzas dri mchog ji snyed yod pa rnams// bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la 'bul// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra gandhe pra tītstsha pu dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ stong gsum 'di 'am stong gsum gzhan dag na// lha rdzas zhal zas ji snyed yod pa rnams// bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la 'bul// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra nai wi dye pra tītstsha pu dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ stong gsum 'di 'am stong gsum gzhan dag na// lha rdzas rol mo ji snyed yod pa rnams// bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la 'bul// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra shabda pra tītstsha pu dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ gis mchod/ oṃ ghaṇḍe ra ṇi sogs sngags so so'i phyag rgya dang rol mo bcas 'bul/ gos zung la dmigs te/ oṃ sumbha ni sa bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i lha'i gos srab pa 'jam pa yang ba dwangs shing thog pa med pa zung du sbyar ba dang ldan par gyur/ kha dog bzang zhing dri zhim reg na bde// srab 'jam yang mdzes lha las byung ba yi// na bza' mchog 'di rdo rje'i sku la 'bul// bgres pa med pa rdo rje'i sku thob shog

/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra badzra wast+ra āḥhūm̐/ zhes sogs gos zung phul/ de nas snying kha nas rigs ma bcu drug spros te/ dkyil 'khor pa rnams mchod par bsam la/ rdo rje lha mo pi waṃ ma// ston ka'i mdog mtshungs pi waṃ lag /pi waṃ sgra dang dbyangs ldan ma// nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badzra wī ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje lha mo gling bu ma// gser gyi mdog can gling bu lag /gling bu'i sgra dang dbyangs ldan ma// nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra sogs sbyar ba'i/ oṃ badzra waṃ se hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje lha mo rnga zlum ma// bandhu'i mdog can rnga zlum lag /rnga zlum sgra dang dbyangs ldan ma// nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi// gong ltar 'gres/ om̐ badzra mṛ daṃ ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje lha mo rdza rnga ma// margad mdog can rdza rnga lag /rdza rnga'i sgra dang dbyangs ldan ma// nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi// gong 'dra/ oṃ badzra mu rdza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje lha mo bzhad pa mo// kiṃ shu'i mdog mtshungs bzhad pa'i zhal// 'dzum pa'i bzhin dang dbyangs ldan ma// nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi// gong sngags/ oṃ badzra hā se hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje lha mo sgeg pa mo// dbang sngon mdog mtshungs sgeg pa'i tshul// snyems pa'i lus dang glu ldan ma// nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi// gong dang 'dra/ oṃ badzra lā sye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje lha mo glu dbyangs ma// 'char ka'i mdog mtshungs glu len ma// snyan pa'i glu dbyangs rol mo bcas// nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi// gong 'dra'i/ oṃ badzra gī ti hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje lha mo gar mkhan ma// margad mdog mtshungs gar sgyur zhing*// gar dang snyan pa'i dbyangs ldan ma// nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi//

gong 'dra/ oṃ badzra nṛ ti hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje lha mo me tog ma// gur gum mdog mtshungs me tog lag /me tog char dang rol mor bcas// nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi/ /gong 'dra/ oṃ badzra puṣpe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje lha mo bdug spos ma// du ba'i mdog mtshungs bdug spos lag /bdug spos sprin dang rol mo bcas// nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi// gong 'dra/ oṃ badzra dhū pe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje lha mo mar me ma// glog 'od mdog mtshungs mar me'i lag /mar me'i 'od dang rol mo bcas// nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi// gong 'dra/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje lha mo dri chab ma// pri yang mdog mtshungs dung chos lag /dri yi char dang rol mo bcas// nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi// gong 'dra/ oṃ badzra gandhe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje lha mo me long ma// chu shel mdog mtshungs me long lag /sna tshogs gzugs kyis mnyes byed ma// nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi// gong 'dra/ badzra rū pa badzrī hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje lha mo zhal zas ma// dza pa'i mdog mtshungs zhal zas lag /zhal zas bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs ma// nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi// gong 'dra/ badzra ra sa badzrī hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje lha mo na bza' ma/ margad mdog mtshungs na bza'i lag /gos dang reg dang 'khyud pa ldan// nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi// gong 'dra/ badzra sparṣe badzrī hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje lha mo chos dbyings ma// kunda'i mdog mtshungs chos 'byung lag /zag pa med pa'i bde ster ma// nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badzra dharma dha tu badzrī hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes mchod la/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dpral bar bcas shing*/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra su ra su ra ā warta ya ā warta ya hoḥ de nas thal mo snying khar sbyar la/

bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la// 'khor lo rin chen 'di phul bas// srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun bcad de// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ tsakra ratna pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams la// nor bu rin chen 'di phul bas// bkres shing phongs pa rgyun bcad de// 'byor ba phun sum tshogs par shog /gong 'dra/ oṃ ma ṇi ratna pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ btsun mo rin chen 'di phul bas// ma rig mun pa rgyun bcad de// shes rab dbyings kyi don rtogs nas// thabs dang shes rab 'brel bar shog / gong 'dra/ wa sti ratna pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ blon po rin chen 'di phul bas// phyi nang gsang gsum theg gsum ldan// bsam yas bstan pa rab 'dzin cing*// yon tan thams cad ldan par shog /ma hā ta ratna pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ glang po rin chen 'di phul bas// lta ngan rnams ni rab bsal nas// bla med theg pa rab zhon te// thams cad mkhyen grong bgrod par shog /hasti ratna pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ rta mchog rin chen 'di phul bas// srid pa'i gzeb las nges grol te// rdzu 'phrul mchog gi shugs thob nas// sangs rgyas zhing du 'gro bar shog /tu raṃ ga a shwo ratna pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ dmag dpon rin chen 'di phul bas/ nyon mongs dgra las rgyal gyur nas// phas kyi rgol ba tshar bcad de// bsnyengs bral mchog ni thob par shog /khaḍga ratna pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang*/ 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pa ni/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan// phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis pa// mos blos bla ma rnal 'byor ma la 'bul// bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra rū pa kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin pa'i// yon tan tshig brjod sgra snyan ci mchis rnams// mos blos bla ma rnal 'byor ma la 'bul// bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra shabda kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ phyogs dus kun na tsandan sbrul snying dang*// a gar la sogs dbang po tshim byed rnams// mos blos bla ma rnal 'byor ma la 'bul// bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra gandhe kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ phyogs dus kun na ro dang bcud ldan pa'i// lus sems brtas byed ro mchog ci mchis rnams// mos blos bla ma rnal 'byor ma la 'bul// bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra ra sa kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ phyogs dus kun na 'jam mnyen 'khril chags pa'i// reg bya'i khyad par lus sems tshims byed rnams// mos blos bla ma rnal 'byor ma la 'bul// bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra sparṣe kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ de rnams phyi'i mchod pa ste/ so so'i sngags dang*/ phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin dang bcas pas 'phul lo// nang gi mchod pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas byin gyis rlabs pa dran par byas la/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis nang mchod dbus nas blangs te thig pa 'thor zhing*/ oṃ mchod do/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ khyab bdag dang po'i sangs rgyas rdo rje chos// rgyal ba'i yum gyur rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// grub pa'i dbang po rdo rje dril bu pa// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/

lhag pa'i lha yis rjes bzung ḍiṃ gi pa// don dam mchog brnyes grub chen antar pa// brtson pas grub pa brnyes pa'i te lo ba// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ paṇa grub 'khor los sgyur pa nā ro pa// snyan brgyud slob bshad 'dzin pa'i pham thing pa// zab lam mthar phyin klog skya shes rab brtsegs// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ skad gnyis smra ba'i lo chen blo gros grags// bstan pa'i mnga' bdag bla chen sa skya pa// de sras thu bo rje btsun sku mched gnyis// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ kun mkhyen gnyis pa sa skya paṇḍi ta// srid zhi'i gtsug rgyan 'phags pa rin po che// chos brgyad 'ching ba kun spangs dkon mchog dpal// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rtse gcig sgrub pa mthar phyin brag phug pa// 'gro ba'i bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal// bshad sgrub chu bo kun 'dus dpal ldan par// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mthu stobs dbang phyug seng ge rgyal mtshan zhabs/

'di nas tshig gsum gsar bsgrigs/ /mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal ba mchog dbyangs dpal// yab rje 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mkhas pa'i dbang po ye shes rgyal mtshan zhabs// rgyal bas lung bstan ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*// 'khor lo sdom pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ༈ /chos kyi rgyal po blo gros rgyal mtshan zhabs// grub pa mchog gi ded dpon rdo ring pa// bstan pa'i srog shing tshar chen rdo rje 'chang*// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ nges pa thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i zhabs// thugs sras mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mchan dpal/ tshig rkang gnyis po gsar bsgrigs/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug bsod nams chos 'phel la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ khyab bdag bla ma dbang phyug rab brtan dpal// rigs kyi bdag po rje btsun bka' 'gyur ba// snyan brgyud mnga' bdag mkhan chen zhwa lu ba// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ paṇa chen ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa dang*// sbas pa'i rnal 'byor buddha ratna'i zhabs// sems dpa' chen po mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang*// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sngags 'chang thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga'i mtshan// 'jam dpal rdo rje bsod nams dbang phyug zhabs// rigs kun khyab bdag maṅga'i mtshan can la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i rigs bdag rdo rje 'chang*// ngur smrig gar gyis rnam rol thams cad mkhyen// mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub zhabs// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/

bla ma gsum gyi thugs las 'khrungs pa'i sras// snyan brgyud gdams pa'i mnga' bdag rdo rje 'chang*// ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub rmor chen zhabs// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ snyan brgyud gdams pa'i chu bo kun 'dus pa// gsang chen bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rdo rje sems// drin chen bla ma kun dga'i mtshan can la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mkha' spyod ma'i sman mchod kha skong ni/ /khyab bdag bla ma kun dga' blo gros dang*// grub rig gtsug rgyan bstan 'dzin lhun grub zhabs// 'od gsal mngon gyur blo gsal phun tshogs la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐// grub pa'i dbang phyug ngag dbang kun mkhyen zhabs// 'khor lo'i mgon po gzim 'og rdo rje 'chang*// rig 'dzin bla ma phyogs las rnam rgyal la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ khyab bdag dkyil 'khor gtso bo zlos gar mchog /lnga sde'i 'dren pa kun mkhyen gu ṇa pa// mgon de'i rjes bzung rig 'dzin ya sha'i mtshan// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsang chen mdzod 'dzin dpal ldan chos kyi rgyal// rim gnyis dbang phyug bstan 'dzin shes rab mchog /mkhas grub mtshungs med ngag dbang klu sgrub la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dri med rgyal bstan spyi dang sa skya'i bstan// rgyas mdzad rin chen mkhyen brtse dbang po'i zhabs// mchog sprul ngag dbang kun dga' bstan 'dzin la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐// gsang chen snyan brgyud zab mo'i mdzod bzung nas// ris med 'gro la legs bshad bdud rtsi'i char// 'bebs mkhas drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/

(khyab bdag bla ma kun dga' blo gros dang*// grub rig gtsug rgyan rigs bdag thar rtse ba// bka' drin mnyam med nam mkha'i mtshan can la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/) gzhan yang smin byed dbang dang grol byed lam// zab mo'i lam gyi man ngag ston mdzad pa// dngos brgyud dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs rnams la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ oṃ oṃ/ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye/ badzra warṇa nī ye/ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ mkha' khyab chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// sna tshogs sprul pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma// bdag gi yi dam rdo rje rnal 'byor mar// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gong gi zur bcos dang 'di nas yid 'byung bar tshig bcad gsar bsgrigs/ gzhan yang gsang sngags bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud// rnal 'byor bla med rgyud sde chen po bzhi// rjes 'brel yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod/ de nas mtheb srin gyis rang gi lce rtse smin mtshams spyi gtsug tu bdud rtsi'i thig le re bya/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod pas phung khams skye mched lha'i ngo bor gsal ba bde bas tshim par gyur par bsam zhing*/ bdud rtsi'i bar phud gtor ma la phul la/ oṃ shrī mahā kā lā ya/ dpal mgon lha mchog rdo rje nag po che// gur gyi mgon po 'dod khams dbang phyug ma// lcam dral bran g.yog bka' sdod 'khor bcas la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ shrī dharmā pā la tsa turmu khā ya/ mthu stobs dbang phyug dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa// yum chen rnam bzhi zhing skyong 'bum sde dang*// dregs byed sde brgyad bka' nyan 'khor tshogs la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/

oṃ shrī re ma ti/ bstan srung gtso mo rdo rje rab brtan ma// chu srin gdong can ming po las mkhan dang*// zhing skyong ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ (mi 'gyur lhun grub bde chen chos dbyings na// grangs med mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo rab brtan ma// chu srin gdong sogs grangs med 'khor bcas la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/) oṃ bai shrā wa ṇā ya/ byang phyogs rin chen mang sprul rnam thos sras// yab yum btsun mo sras kyi tshogs rnams dang*// gnod sbyin nor lha'i 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ghṛ rā dza ghṛ rā dza ku ma ku ma khum this swā hā/ o rgyan yul gyi zhing skyong gsang chen gnyer// mthu stobs dbang phyug nor skyong dur khrod bdag /yab yum bka' nyan sha za 'bum sde la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ shrī mahā ra dzā ya/ dpag yas mthu stobs bye ba'i bdag nyid kyi// mtshan tsam dran pas nad gdon byur las skyob// chos rgyal sku lnga dregs byed 'khor bcas la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos 'khor skyong zhing bstan pa srung ba dang*// sgrub po 'khor bcas skyong ba'i dam can tshogs// bka' sdod chos skyong srung ma 'khor bcas la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gnas mchog bzhi dang nye ba'i gnas mchog bzhi// mkha' spyod thugs kyi 'khor lo'i bdag nyid can// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i 'khor tshogs ma lus la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhing mchog gnyis dang nye ba'i zhing mchog gnyis// tshando ha zung nye ba'i tshando gnyis// sa spyod gsung gi 'khor lo'i rang bzhin gyi// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs thams cad la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/

'du ba gnyis dang nye ba'i 'du ba gnyis// dur khrod zung dang nye ba'i dur khrod gnyis// sa 'og legs spyod sku 'khor ngo bo nyid// dpa' bo rnal 'byor sprul sku thams cad la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'thung spyod nye ba'i 'thung spyod zhes pa sogs// ngo mtshar mkha' 'gro'i gnas na bzhugs pa yi// 'gro ba sems can don mdzad ma tshogs la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ so gnyis yul dang nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas// dur khrod chen po brgyad na legs bzhugs pa'i// bsam gyis mi khyab dpa' bo rnal 'byor mar// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhing skyong bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pho nya'i tshogs// gnas rigs sngags dang las las skyes pa yi// gnas gsum rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gnod sbyin srin po 'byung po yi dwags tshogs// sha za smyo byed rjed byed pho nya'i tshogs// 'phrog ma grub pa rig 'dzin ma lus par// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bod khams nyer skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis po// bka' nyan bran g.yog gzhan yang gnas yul grong*// gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas pa 'khor bcas la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud rnam pa lnga// skye gnas bzhis bsdus khams gsum sems can rnams// tshim zhing zag med bde bas rgyud gang nas// myur du bla med byang chub thob gyur cig /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing*/ de nas rang gi lce rtses bdud rtsi myang la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ brjod pa la gsung rdo rje mnyes par bsams la/ yid 'byung gi mchod pa ni/ ༈ na mo chos kyi dbyings kyi byin rlabs dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje rnam par dag pa'i byin rlabs dang*/

gsang sngags dang phyag rgya'i nus mthu dang bdag gi mos pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ smon lam gyi dbang gis 'jig rten gyi khams na bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i mchod pa'i bye brag ji snyed yod pa dang*/ gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bla ma dang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra su ra su ra ā warta ya ā warta ya hoḥ na maḥs manta buddha nāṃ/ a bhi sma ra ya spha ra ṇa i māṃ ga ga na khaṃ dharmā dhā tu ā kā shā sa manta maṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta ā pa ri sho dha ya maṇḍal le ma ma pra ṇi dhi puṇye dzñā na bā le na/ sarba ta thā ga ta ba lendha bandha swā stha naṃ ba lenna tsā ye swā hā/ zhes pas phyag rgya dang bcas pa bya/ de nas bstod pa ni/ rol chen bya zhing*/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te badzra wā ra hī bam̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo ārya a pa rā dzi te trai lo kya mā te mahā wi rye shwa rī hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo sarba bhū ta bha yā wā he ma hā badzre hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badzra ā sa ni a dzi te a pa rā dzi te washyaṃ ka ri ne tra bhrā ma ṇi ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo bi ṣa ni sho ṣa ṇī ro ṣa ṇī kro dha kā ra lī ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥst+rā sa ni mā ra ṇi pra bhe da ni a pa rā dza ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo bi dza ye dzambha ni st+wambha ni mo ha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badzra wa rā hī ma hā yo gi nī kā me shwa rī kha gai hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bya ba dang*/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yis 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum brnyes// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog pa'i 'chings gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya bar rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo//

zhes shlau ka gnyis dang spros pa la dga' na rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bstod pa ni/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas tshig bcad rnams la g.yas pa'i rdo rjes phyag 'tshal ba'i stangs kas snying gar bzung zhing*/ g.yon pas dril bu shlau ka re re'i mtshams su gsil la/ ye shes chen po'i mdzod 'dzin chos kyi rje// dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gus btud nas// rgyal ba'i yum gyur rdo rje rnal 'byor mar// dang ba'i sems kyis cung zad bstod par bgyi// 'dab brgya lte bar nyin mor byed pa'i dbus// zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'bar ba'i spyan gsum g.yo// padma rā ga ltar dmar rje btsun ma// mkha' spyod longs spyod rdzogs la phyag 'tshal lo// chags chen skyes bu 'dul bar bya ba'i phyir// brtan g.yo'i bdag po he ru ka dpal dang*// gnyis med lhan skyes gar gyis rol mdzad ma// mkha' spyod kha sbyor che la phyag 'tshal lo// nyid thugs zag pa med pa'i bde ba che// 'gyur med dga' ba gya nom bla na med// rgyun mi chad pa'i bde ba'i ros gang ba// mkha' spyod bde ba che la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam dag chos dbyings spros bral nam mkha'i dbyings// mtha' yas yon tan mang pos nyer mdzes pa'i// rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang rab ldan ma// mkha' spyod rang bzhin med la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi rang bzhin rnam par mi rtog kyang*// thugs rje chen pos sems can ma lus par// yid bzhin nor ltar dgos 'dod kun stsol ma// mkha' spyod snying rjes yongs gang la phyag 'tshal// srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' dang bral ba yi// mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa'i sa brnyes nas// rgyun chad med par 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma// mkha' spyod rgyun chad med la phyag 'tshal lo// dmigs med snying rje'i gzhan gyi dbang bsgyur nas// 'khor ba ji srid gnas pa de srid du// mya ngan mi 'da' rtag par rab bzhugs ma// mkha' spyod 'gogs pa med la phyag 'tshal lo// dbang bzhi'i don ldan bskyed rim zab mo'i lam// thun bzhir bsgom zhing gus pas gsol btab pas// sku bzhi dbyer med zung 'jug rdo rje'i sku// mkha' spyod sku yi byin gyis brlab tu gsol// oṃ gsum ldan pa'i gsang sngags yi ge'i tshogs// dus gsum ngag dang yid kyis rab bzlas pas// srid gsum sgra dbyangs rnam spangs brjod bral gsung*// mkha' spyod gsung gis byin gyis brlab tu gsol// bden gnyis rnam dag rdzogs rim dbu ma'i lam/

sgrib gnyis sbyang phyir brtson pas legs bsgoms pas// don gnyis lhun grub 'gyur med bde ba'i thugs// mkha' spyod thugs kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol// de ltar bstod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// nyid thugs brtse ba chen pos rjes bzung nas// tshe 'di nyid dam bar do la sogs par// mkha' spyod chen mo'i go 'phang thob par shog / ces pas bstod/ ༈ spro na/ rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i zhing gi bkod pa dang mthun pa'i bstod pa mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i them skas zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

oṃ swa sti/ sras bcas rgyal ba kun gyis rab bsngags pa'i// grangs med ma dang mkha' 'gro brten pa'i gnas// rdo rje btsun mo mchog gi pho brang che// mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas der gus pas 'dud// 'di nas steng gi phyogs su rab bgrod pa'i// padma rā ga'i sa gzhi brdal ba'i dbus// phyogs mtshams thams cad rin po che las grub// sa gzhi khyad par 'phags der gsol ba 'debs// de dbus rin chen lnga las legs grub pa'i// mkha' spyod dbang mo'i gzhal med khang chen po// gru bzhi sgo bzhi thog phug rim gsum brtsegs// rdo rje'i tog gis mdzes der gsol ba 'debs// gzhal med khang dbus chos 'byung nyis brtsegs nang*// padma nyi ma 'jigs byed dus mtshan steng*// bdag gi yi dam rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar der gsol ba 'debs// zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum gyen du gzigs// g.yas pas gri gug g.yon pas thod khrag dang*// g.yon gyi gru mor kha ṭwāṃ ka yis mdzes// phyag rgya lnga yis spras der gsol ba 'debs// gzhal med khang gi steng gi ba gam nang*// nā ro ta pa bla chen brtse ba che// tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po la sogs pa'i// brgyud pa'i tshogs rnams bzhugs der gsol ba 'debs// pho brang steng mar rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*// dbyer med rigs bdag sangs rgyas rdo rje chos// sku mdog dmar po rdor dril thugs kar bsnol// skyabs gsum 'dus pa'i ngo bor gsol ba 'debs// gzhal med khang gi 'khyams dang phyogs kun tu// mkha' la spyod pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ sprin gyi phung po stib ltar bzhugs pa kun// bdag la brtse bas dgongs der gsol ba 'debs// de ltar bdag gi tshe rabs thams cad du// nye bar bsten pa'i rje btsun rnal 'byor ma// rten dang brten par bcas pa thams cad la// byang chub bar du gus pas skyabs su mchi// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod// lus ngag yid kyi sdig ltung so sor bshags// skyes 'phags dge ba kun la rjes yi rangs// theg chen chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// mya ngan mi 'da' rtag par bzhugs su gsol// dge tshogs bla med byang chub chen por bsngo// deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du// rdo rje btsun mos nye bar bskyang du gsol// mkha' spyod zhing gtso phyi yi rnal 'byor ma// snying ga'i bam̐ yig nang gi btsun mo che// gsal stong zung 'jug don gyi rnal 'byor ma// rang ngo shes nas mkha' spyod bgrod par shog

/nam zhig sgyu ma'i skyes chen 'degs pa'i tshe// gtan gyi skyabs gcig mkha' spyod dbang mo des// 'dzum pa'i bzhin dang glu dbyangs rol mo'i sgrs// dag pa'i zhing der 'khrid par mdzad du gsol// zhes mkha' spyod zhing gi bkod pa dang mthun pa'i bstod pa mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i them skas zhes bya ba 'di yang rdo rje btsun mo'i zhabs la mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang ldan pa mkhyen blo bstan don gyi nan gyis bskul ma gnang ba'i ngor bya bral lhun grub kyis lha ldan gandho la'i dbang phyogs su bris pa 'dis kyang sems can dpag tu med pa'i don byed par gyur cig oṃ gsum ma grangs mang bzlas rjes/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor ba thams cad brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol// ༈ / de nas bum pa bsgrub pa ni/ oṃ sumbha ni sumbha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhṇa zhes pa nas bidyā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dang a las zla ba'i steng du bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyi mgul la dkris pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis yongs su gang ba'i bum pa'i nang du/ e e las chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bam̐ yig dmar po'i mthar g.yon bskor du/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye sogs nas/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags phreng kha dog dmar pos bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yig 'bru rnams la thim pa yongs su gyur pa las rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa ni/

sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma'i steng nas mnan pa/ g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po mgo bo rgyab tu bltabs nas mnan pa/ sku mdog dmar mo bskal pa'i me lta bu'i gzi brjid can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dag pa mkha' spyod du gzigs pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug thur du brkyangs nas 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba steng phyogs su bzung nas zhal gyen du phyogs pas gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yon par rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭwāṃ ga la ḍā ma ru dang*/ dril bu dang 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyang bzhin pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pas sku sked yan chad khebs pa/ lang tsho dar la bab cing 'dod pa'i nu 'bur rgyas pa/ bde ba skyed pa'i nyams can/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// de nas 'bar ba'i phyag rgya smin mtshams su g.yon bskor du lan gsum bskor zhing ngag tu/ phai/ཾ rang gi thugs ka'i bam̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ pad kor gyi mthar 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ yo ga shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shuddho3haṃ/ de'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar ham̐ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hrīṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇḍi kā'i ngo bor gyur/

slar yang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma yā shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra pādyaṃ pra tītstsha zhes sogs nas/ shabda pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ oṃ badzra ghaṇḍe ra ṇi ta zhes sogs nas/ āḥkhaṃ swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes nang mchod phul la rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum brnyes// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun du rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya bar rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod la pad kor sngon du 'gro ba'i gzungs thag bzung la/ rang gi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba byung ste gzungs thag la 'khril nas song*/ rje btsun ma'i sku la phog pas ba spu'i bu ga nas bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun byung bas bum pa gang bar gyur par bsams la/ oṃ oṃ oṃ/

sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye/ badzra warṇa nī ye/ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ brgya rtsa dang*/ oṃ sumbha ni sumbha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhṇa sogs nas bī dyā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ nyer gcig oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣi ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ nyer gcig la sogs pa ji ltar rigs pa bzlas/ mchod bstod ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇā sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra pādyaṃ pra zhes sogs nas/ shabda pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ oṃ badzra ghaṇḍe ra ṇi ta sogs nas/ āḥkhaṃ swā hā/ zhes rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul la/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum brnyes// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya bar rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bdag dang sems can thams cad dag pa mkha' spyod du 'khrid par mdzad du gsol/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ oṃ shrī badzra he ru ka sa ma ya zhes sogs nas sa twa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum brjod/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal pa// de kun mgon pos bzod par gsol// dung chos kyi mchod yon 'bul/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bum nang gi lha zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chu nus pa dang ldan par gyur ces brjod// ༈ /bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs dam gnad nas bskul ba'i gsol 'debs lam rim dang 'brel ba mkha' spyod bgrod ba'i them skas zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

༈ / sras bcas rgyal ba kun gyi yum gcig pu// dpal ldan bla ma mkha' spyod dbang mo'i zhabs// snying nas dran pa'i gdung bas gsol 'debs na// byin rlabs char chen phob cig rnal 'byor ma// bdag cag deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar// rdo rje'i lus thob theg chen rigs sad nas// mtshan ldan bla ma tshul bzhin bsten nus pa'i// skal pa bzang por sbyor cig rnal 'byor ma// khams gsum 'khor ba sdug bsngal phung por rig /dal 'byor rnyed dka' nam 'chi nges med dran// las 'bras blang dor brtson sogs thun mong gi /lam rim rgyud la skyed cig rnal 'byor ma// khyad par rnam dag dbang dang byin rlabs kyis// rgyud smin dam tshig sdom par ldan pa las// smin grol lam bzang 'jug cing bsgom rung ba'i// zab mo'i rten 'brel sgrigs shig rnal 'byor ma// de tshe dben zhing bsam gtan 'phel ba'i sar// nang gi rnal 'byor rtse gcig gzhol ba na// phyi nang gsang ba'i 'gal rkyen kun zhi zhing*// mthun rkyen rgyas par mdzod cig rnal 'byor ma// nyal dus 'od gsal ngang du mnyam bzhag cing*// ldang tshe zung 'jug sgyu ma'i skur gsal bas// dga' ba gsum ldan bdud rtsi myangs pa'i mthus// sgo gsum dag par mdzod cig rnal 'byor ma// bla ma mchog gsum skyabs kyi snying por bzung*// byams dang snying rje byang sems gting nas 'byongs// stobs bzhi tshang ba'i rdor sems sgom bzlas kyis// sdig ltung byang bar mdzod cig rnal 'byor ma// dngos grub 'byung gnas khyab bdag rdo rje chos// dad pas bsgoms shing mchod cing gsol btab mthus// byin rlabs bdud rtsis dbang bzhi'i ye shes kyis// padmo lhag par rgyas mdzod rnal 'byor ma// bdag gzhan sbyang zhing bsgyur ba'i bskyed rim gyis// lhar snang gcig tu shar ba'i dam tshig par// ye shes pho nya gsum gyi byin rlabs rgyun// 'jug cing brtan par mdzod cig rnal 'byor ma// nga rgyal rnam pa'i sems 'dzin la brten nas// rim pa dang po'i gsal snang mthar phyin cing*// ngag dang yid kyi bzlas pas mkha' spyod kyi// dngos grub 'grub par mdzod cig rnal 'byor ma// phyi nang khams gsum bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i// 'od gsal ngang du thim pa'i skad cig las// lha sngags chos skur 'char ba'i spyod lam gyis// tshogs gnyis rdzogs par mdzod cig rnal 'byor ma// rtsa rlung thig le smin cing sbyang ba'i phyir// gtum mo'i me lces dbu ma'i sgo dbye zhing*// rlung gi sbyor bas lus sems sim pa las// bde stong ye shes 'grub mdzod rnal 'byor ma// de ltar sgom bzlas sgrub la brtson pa'i mthus// grub pa'i dbang phyug ku sā li pa bzhin// mngon sum lag pa'i mkhrig ma nas bzung ste// mkha' spyod grong du 'khrid cig rnal 'byor ma// der ni zhing skyes pho nya'i tshogs rnams kyis// rdo rje'i nyams 'gyur rdzogs pa'i yan lag gis// kun tu 'khyud cing tsumba sngon 'gro bas// snyoms 'jug bde chen skyed mdzod rnal 'byor ma// de tshe bde bas drangs pa'i stong pa nyid// mthong ba'i lam gyi 'od gsal mngon gyur nas// slob dang mi slob kha sbyor bdun ldan gyi// zung 'jug thob par mdzod cig rnal 'byor ma// gal te tshe 'dir brtan pa ma thob na// 'chi tshe mgon dang dpa' bo ma tshogs kyis// yid 'phrod mchod pa'i sprin gyis mdun bsus te// dag pa'i zhing du drongs shig rnal 'byor ma// der yang 'khrul nas bar dor 'khyams srid na// bla ma mchog dang rdo rje btsun mo yis// ming nas lung ston dga' ba rnam gsum gyi// dbugs dbyung lhag par stsol cig rnal 'byor ma// mdor na skye zhing skye ba thams cad du// dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor mas// 'bral ba med par rtag tu rjes bzung zhing*// phan bde'i dge mtshan rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog

/ ces pa'ang 'di phyi'i 'dun pa bla ma mchog gsum gyi bka' drin kho na la re ba rgyal khams kyi bya bral ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos khyab bdag 'khor lo sdom pa'i pho brang srin po ri'i dpal 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum gyi snang brnyan ye shes pa mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar ji ltar gsol ba bzhin/ slad nas kyang gsol ba btab pa'i dge bas bdag dang 'gro kun bla ma rje btsun mas dus rtag tu rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //sarba dā shrī yo bha ba tu// ༈ /de nas bdag 'jug la mdun bskyed kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang*/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dang gnyis su med pa la dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba mngon sum ltar dmigs la/ de ltar dgongs pa rtse gcig pas bdag la dgongs par bsam ste/

ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis khrus gsol lo// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣi ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes pas bum chu cung zad myang*/ rang gi lus longs spyod dge ba'i rtsa ba dang bcas pa yon du phul bar bsams la/ oṃ badzra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi yongs su dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ oṃ badzra re khe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri khor yug gis bskor ba'i dbus su hūm̐/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling*/ nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mi dad pa la byin rlabs zab mo zhu ba'i yon du 'bul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes pas yon phul nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi// dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum brnyes// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro mas// bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ de nas rdo rje rnal 'byor mas mdzad par bsam la/ āḥkhaṃ wī ra hūm̐ gis gdong ras bcings/ āḥkhaṃ wī ra hūm̐ gis me tog gi phreng ba blang*/ sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor las khro mo khaṇḍa ro hi dpag tu med pa 'phros te/ byin rlabs zab mo zhu ba la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad par gyur

par bsams la/ ku shas bum chu rang la 'thor zhing*/ oṃ sumbha ni sumbha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa zhes sogs nas/ bidyā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod lce la myang bas sems bde bas gang*/ nang gi bag chags thams cad dag par mos/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga'// skal bzang bdag ni bde ba chen po la'o// de yis bu la ci zhig bya// sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go / zhes pas rigs dang 'dun pa ched du bya ba dris shing nges par byas/ rang gi snying ga'i nang du zla ba la gnas pa'i rdo rje dkar po kun rdzob dang*/ don dam pa'i byang chub sems kyi ngo bor gyur par bsams la/ de nyid rje btsun mas rdo rje snying khar bzhag nas brtan par byin gyis brlabs par bsam zhing*/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsitta utpa da yā mi/ zhes dang*/ su ra te sa ma ya st+waṃ hoḥsiddhi badzra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod/ rnal 'byor mas gsang bar gdams par bsams la rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ deng khyod rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyis/ rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no// zhes rnal 'byor ma'i phyag na gnas pa'i rdo rje la 'jus te dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na rnal 'byor ma bzhugs pa'i drung du slebs par mos la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pa ni phyi 'jug go /nang 'jug gi don du rnal 'byor ma'i drung du yan lag bdun pa dang ldan pa'i sgo nas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed par mos la/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge ba rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog

/ ces lan gsum brjod/ rigs lnga spyi dang khyad par gyi dam tshig gong 'phel du bzung bar bsams la/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis ni// dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// so sor brtan por gzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i// sdom pa deng nas brtan por gzung*// rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// padma'i rigs mchog dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni ma lus gzung*// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan pa ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las ni ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma byin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// ces lan gsum brjod/ khyad par du g.yon pa'i kun spyod kyi dam tshig spyir bud med la mi smod pa dang*/

khyad par shes rab ma la brten pa'i dam tshig brgyad po gzung snyam pas/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// rnal 'byor gsang sngags mkha' 'gro ma// 'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid can// kun la rtag tu skyabs su mchi// dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo// byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che// khyad par du yang slob dpon la// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// dpal ldan khrag 'thung sogs dpa' bo// rnal 'byor ma dang snang mdzad sogs// byang chub sems dpa' dpag med pa// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag gis dus 'di nas bzung ste// ji srid gnyis med la gnas par// de yi tshangs spyod gnyis med pa// nyi shu rtsa gnyis legs par gzung*// zhes lan gsum brjod/ de nas/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ rang gi lus la phog pas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa dang rnam smin sha rus kyi bar du sbyangs te mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las e e las chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi dbus su bam̐ yig dmar po'i mthar oṃ oṃ oṃ/ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye/ badzra warṇa nī ye/ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/ rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ de rnams 'od du zhu nas tshur 'dus yig 'bru rnams la thim pa yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa ni/ sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma'i steng nas mnan pa/ g.yon bskums pas 'jig byed nag po'i mgo bo rgyab tu bltabs nas mnan pa/ sku mdog dmar mo bskal pa'i me lta bu'i gzi brjid can/

zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dag pa mkha' spyod du gzigs pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug thur du brkyangs nas 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba steng phyogs su bzung nas zhal gyen du phyogs pas gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yon par rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭwāṃ ga la ḍā ma ru dang dril bu dang 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyang bzhin pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pas sku rked yan chad khebs pa/ lang tsho dar la bab cing 'dod pa'i nu 'bur rgyas pa/ bde ba skyed pa'i nyams can/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i lte bar e e las chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi dbus su bam̐ yig dmar po/ mdun rgyab gnyis spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa re yod par gyur par bsam/ bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mi dad pa la mos gus chen pos gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ bla ma dang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mi dad pas/ (slob dpon rin po ches/) bdag la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs dang yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi dngos grub dang*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal zhing brtan par mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab pas/ sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na bzhugs pa'i rje btsun ma'i thugs ka nas de 'dra ba'i rje btsun ma mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam pa zhig dmar hril gyis byon nas rang gi khar thogs med du zhugs par gyur par bsams la ting lo mar me yod na de nyid/ oṃ oṃ oṃ zhes sogs nas phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā zhes brjod cing rang gi khar bcug par bsams la/ rnal 'byor ma de nyid rang gi spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar la gar stabs mdzad cing yar 'khyug mar 'khyug mdzad pa'i mthar lte ba'i bam̐ yig la thim pas de nyid rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa ni/

sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma'i steng nas mnan pa/ g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po'i mgo bo rgyab tu bltabs nas mnan pa/ sku mdog dmar mo bskal ba'i me lta bu'i gzi brjid can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dag pa mkha' spyod du gzigs pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug thur du brkyangs nas 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba steng phyogs su bzung nas zhal gyen du phyogs pas gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yon par rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭwāṃ ga la ḍā ma ru dang*/ dril bu dang*/ 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyang bzhin pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pas sku rked yan chad khebs pa/ lang tsho dar la bab cing 'dod pa'i nu 'bur rgyas pa/ bde ba skyed pa'i nyams can/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// rang nyid phyi'i rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar ham̐ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇḍi kā'i ngo bor gyur/ ces brjod cing bsams la/ lte ba'i bam̐ yig de nyid gdod ma nas nang gi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yin pa de thabs 'dis gsal btab pa yin no// de nas mdun bskyed kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba rnams kyis dges pa'i gar mdzad/ sngags kyi sgra chen po sgrog cing*/ gtso mo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rnam par byon te rang gi spyi bor thim par gyur

par bsams la/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki sogs nas phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā drag tu brjod cing ḍā dril dkrol/ gu gul gyi dud pas bdug slar yang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas kyang rje btsun ma'i sku dpag tu med pa byung ste rang gi spyi bo nas thim par gyur par bsams la/ sngar bzhin sngags dang spos rol bya ba ni phyi'i rnal 'byor ma spyan drangs pa'i sgo nas dbab pa yin/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i smin mtshams nas gsang gnas kyi bar du rtsa dbu ma kha dog dmar po sbub stong sbom phra mda' smyug 'bring po tsam pa'i mas snar dga' ba 'khyil pa kha dog dmar po g.yon bskor du shugs drag tu 'khor bas dbu ma'i nang nas yar bya 'phur ba bzhin snying ga'i thad du song bas lus sems thams cad bde bas khyab par gyur par bsams/ dbu ma'i yas snar dga' ba 'khyil pa kha dog dkar po g.yon bskor du shugs drag tu 'khor bas/ dbu ma'i nang nas mar 'khor bzhin pas snying ga'i thad du byung bas snang ba thams cad stong nyid kyi ngang du thim zhing*/ dga' 'khyil de gnyis snying gar ro gcig tu 'dres pas bde stong gnyis med kyi ye shes ngo bo dga' ba 'khyil ba dmar skya shugs drag tu 'khor ba dang*/ mthar de nyid kyang nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba bzhin tu gyur par bsams la/ brjod med kyi ngang du ji tsam gnas kyi bar du mnyam par bzhag cing spos rol bya ba ni gsang ba bde stong dbyer med kyi rnal 'byor ma ngo sprad pa yin/ zhes gsang bar gdams pa ni/ dhu dhu ra gu hya sa ma yaḥ de ltar byin rlabs zhugs pa de mi 'bral zhing brtan par bsams la/ lus kyi go cha'i lha rnams dran pas/ oṃ bam̐/ ham̐ yoṃ/ hriṃ moṃ/ hriṃ hriṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces tshar gcig brjod cing spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag la/ tiṣṭha badzra zhes brjod cing byin gyis rlabs kyi myong ba la cung zad mnyam par bzhag

me tog gi phreng ba rje btsun ma'i thugs kar phul bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ pra tītstsha badzra hoḥ zhes pas sindhu ra'i maṇḍal gyi dbus su phul ba'i stangs ka tsam byas la/ me tog gi phreng ba de nyid sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs nas/ rje btsun mas rang gi spyi bor bzhag par mos la/ oṃ pra ti gṛhṇa st+waṃ/ i maṃ sa twa ma hā ba la zhes gsung bar bsam zhing spyi bor bzhag de ltar sems dang bam̐ lhan cig skyes pa'i phag mor ye nas gnas pa cho ga de dag gis gsal bar byas pas dkyil 'khor mthong ba la sgrib byed bsal ba'i mtshon byed du/ rnal 'byor mas gdong g.yogs dkrol bar mos te/ rnal 'byor ma dpal deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong gyur pa// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// oṃ badzra nai tra a pa hā ra pa ṭa laṃ hrīḥpraṃ/ ces dang*/ khyed rnams rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor la ltos zhes gsung zhing*/ bltas pas rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad mngon sum du mthong bar gyur
