par mos/ de dag ni 'jug pa'i chos 'khor dang bcas pa'o// dngos gzhi'i dbang byin rlabs kyi tshul bskur ba la/ maṇḍal bshams la/ maṇḍal ri rab gling bzhi nyi zla zung gcig lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mi dad pa la byin rlabs zab mo zhu ba'i yon du 'bul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes pas yon phul/ rnal 'byor ma dpal dbang bskur bas// 'gro ba skyob pa'i gzi brjid can// ji ltar yon tan 'byung gnas gtso// de bzhin bdag la deng stsol cig / ces pa'am/ yang na/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la// mchod chen ji ltar stsal pa ltar// bdag kyang skyob pa'i don gyi phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol// ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ rang nyid sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma 'jigs byed dus mtshan gyi gdan la skad cig gis rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i steng du gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can/ mtha' bskor du mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor bar gyur/ phaiṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ rje btsun ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dbang gi lha dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar bkra lam gyis byon pa'i he ru ka yab yum gyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhis rdo rje'i glu len/ khaṇḍa ka pā li la sogs pa'i dpa' bo rnams kyis shis pa brjod/ rab tu gtum mo la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis mchod pa'i las rtsom/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyis bgegs dang log par 'dren pa'i tshogs thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad par gyur

par bsams la/ me tog 'thor zhing dril bu gsil bas/ ༈ bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las las byung ba'i// he ru ka dpal 'jigs byed rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku// shes rab phag mo'i padmar rdo rjes rol mdzad pa'i// bkra shis des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi 'byung gnas nyams dga' bar// sna tshogs chu skyes nyin byed gdan la bde bar bzhugs// rgyal ba ma lus skyed pa'i yum mchog rnal 'byor ma// bkra shis des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig gsang chen zab mo'i don ston pa// mkha' 'gro grangs med gsung gi snying po sum cu gnyis// sa gsum khyab pa'i 'od zer bye ba'i 'phro 'du can// bkra shis des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig 'gyur med lhun gyis grub pa'i dbyings// khams gsum kun la bde ba chen pos khyab pa'i thugs// tshad med yon tan phrin las 'od kyis cher 'bar ba// bkra shis des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig zhing skyong ma mo'i tshogs rnams kyis// bdud dang bgegs 'joms zhi rgyas dbang gi las mdzad cing*// srung ba'i 'khor lo rgya chen rtag tu gnas gyur pa// bkra shis des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi bkra shis 'di sgrub mchod kyi cha rkyen du dge slong puṇḍa pas bris pa lags/ he ru ka dpal 'bar ba'i sku mnga' ba// ha ha'i gad rgyang sa gsum g.yo bar byed// hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa bdud kyi klad 'gems pa'i// bde mchog 'khor lo'i bkra shis deng 'dir stsol// e waṃ mnyam par sbyor ba sngags kyi sku// ā li kā li gnyis med rol pa'i gsung*// oṃ kyi ngo bor son pa'i thugs mnga' ba// rdo rje phag mo'i bkra shis deng 'dir stsol// zhes brjod/ de nas gtso bo'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyis zla ba ltar dkar ba'i bum pa byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi lngas yongs su gang bar yal 'dab dang bcas pa cung zad yo bar 'dzin pas byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun gyis spyi bo nas dbang bskur bar gyur

par bsams la/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ tsa kra bī ra st+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ kā kā sya/ ū lu kā sya/ shwa na ka sya/ sū ka rā sya/ ya ma da dhī ya ma du tī/ ya ma daṃṣṭi ṇī/ ya ma ma thā nī/ badzrī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ dbang lha rnams dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas rang gi spyi bo nas thim/ rang nyid khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por dbang bskur ba la rje btsun ma 'khor bcas kyis rab gnas mdzad par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzrā ye swā hā/ zhes brjod cing me tog gtor ba ni dbang gi dngos gzhi'o// mdun bskyed kyi rje btsun ma'i thugs ka'i bam̐ yig las sngags kyi phreng ba kha dog dmar po chu las chu bur rdol ba'i tshul du thol thol byung*/ rje btsun ma'i zhal nas 'thon/ rang gi khar zhugs/ snying ga'i bam̐ yig la thim par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye/ badzra warṇa nī ye/ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ de nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mkha' spyod sgrub nas yi dam gyi lhar bzung snyam pas me tog 'thor zhing*/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// zhes lan gsum brjod/ rje btsun mas me tog gi phreng ba de nyid sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs te/ rang gi spyi gtsug tu bzhag cing gsungs par bsam la/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs// zhes lan gsum brjod/ sindhu ra'i rdul tshon nas g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis blangs te/

dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying kha rnams su thig le bya zhing*/ oṃ oṃ oṃ zhes sogs nas/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ sku tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag rnal 'byor ma'i sku bsgom pa la dbang zhing sku'i byin rlabs dang dngos grub thams cad thob pa yin no// zhes brjod cing rje btsun mas gsungs par bsam/ gsang dbang gi don du dmigs pa 'di ltar bya zhing*/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub sems kyi thig le thod pa'i nang du lhung ba/ rje btsun mas rang gi lce thog tu bzhag par gyur par bsam/ oṃ oṃ oṃ zhes sogs/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod cing g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis thod pa'i nang nas bdud rtsi blangs te lce thog tu bzhag mgrin pa'i lam nas myang bas/ lus kyi rtsa nang gi byang sems dam tshig pa'i tshul dang dbyer med ro gcig tu 'dres pas rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa dbyings su dag cing gsal stong bde bas brgyan pa'i ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skyes par gyur par bsams la cung zad mnyam par bzhag de ltar na gsung bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag rnal 'byor ma'i gsung gsang ba sngags kyi bzlas brjod byed pa la dbang zhing*/ gsung gi byin rlabs dang dngos grub thams cad thob pa yin no// zhes brjod cing rje btsun mas gsung bar bsam/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ni/ phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa dpal he ru kar gyur pa dang*/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i mkha' nang du byin par gyur par bsams la/ sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor nas g.yon pa'i srin lag gi rtses blangs la/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sogs nas/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/

lte ba/ snying ga mgrin pa/ dpral ba rnams su mas nas yar thig le bya/ mkha' nang gi byang chub kyi sems de nyid lte bar drangs pas lte ba'i rtsa 'khor thams cad byang chub sems kyis gang bas dga' ba'i ye shes nyams su myang*/ de bzhin du snying gar drangs pas snying ga'i rtsa 'khor thams cad gang bas mchog dga'i ye shes nyams su myang*/ mgrin par drangs pas mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor gang bas dga' bral gyi ye shes nyams su myang*/ spyi bor drangs pas rtsa 'khor gang*/ de'i tshe lus thams cad la rtsas khyab/ rtsa thams cad la byang chub sems kyis khyab/ byang chub kyi sems la bde bas khyab/ bde ba la stong pas khyab/ bde stong zung 'jug lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba nyams su myang bar gyur par bsam la cung zad mnyam par bzhag de ltar na thugs sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ sems kyi dri ma dag thugs gnyis med kyi ye shes bsgom pa la dbang zhing thugs kyi byin rlabs dang dngos grub thams cad thob pa yin no// zhes brjod cing gsung bar bsam/ dbang bzhi pa ni/ mdun bskyed rje btsun ma'i zhal nas/ dngos po med pa'i chos nyid chos// nam mkha' lta bu dri ma med// stong nyid ye shes rdo rje yi// stong pa nyid du rnam par bsgom// zhes gsung bar bsams/ de'i don ni/ bden pa'i dngos po cung zad tsam yang ye nas yod ma myong ba chos thams cad kyi chos nyid ces bya ba ni yod med rtag chad srid zhi'i mtha' thams cad bral bas nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu/ de'i ngo bo gzung 'dzin gyi spros pa'i dri mas gdod ma nas gos ma myong bas dri ma med pa/ de lta bu'i yul stong pa nyid dang yul can gnyis snang thams cad nub pa'i gnyis med ye shes kyi rdo rje stong nyid du rnam par bsgom zhes pas zung 'jug bde ba chen po rgyud la skyes par gyur/ de'i ngang du cung zad mnyam par bzhag de ltar na rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i sgo nas dbang bzhi pa thob/

sgo gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba mtha' dag bsgom pa la dbang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs dang dngos grub thams cad thob pa yin no// zhes gsung bar bsams shing brjod/ de ltar khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa bsrung snyam pas/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi// zhes lan gsum brjod/ byin rlabs thob pa'i bka' drin gyi yon du/ oṃ badzra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi yongs su dag pa sogs nas/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mi dad pa la byin rlabs zab mo legs par thob pa'i bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du 'bul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lus longs spyod rnams kyang 'bul zhing cha shas nas longs spyod du gsol snyam pas/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du sogs nas/ cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol// lan gsum brjod// ༈ /de nas gtor ma rnams nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs la/ oṃ swā bhā wa sogs nas shuddho3haṃḥ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ zhes pa phyag rgya dang bcas pa lan gsum sogs brjod cing byin gyis brlabs la/ phaiṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min gyi gnas nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma chos skyong ba dang 'jig rten skyong ba'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ pad skor sngon du 'gro ba'i rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'i mthar se gol gtogs pa dang bcas pa bya zhing*/

oṃ oṃ oṃ zhes sogs nas phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sogs nas swā hā zhes lan gsum mam lnga'am bdun gyis phul la/ oṃ badzra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ sogs nas shabda āḥhūm̐ gis phyi mchod 'bul/ oṃ badzra ā ralli hoḥ.oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo// zhes nang mchod gtor/ bstod pa ni/ ḍā ma rus 'go 'dren gyis rol chen bya zhing*/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum brnyes// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya bar rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod la/ 'chi tshe mgon dang dpa' bo ma tshogs kyis// me tog gdugs dang rgyal mtshan thogs nas su// rol mo glu dbyangs sgra snyan sogs mchod cing*// mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su 'khrid par shog /dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /mkha' spyod ma dngos 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog / de nas mgon po che chung gi gtor ma rgyas par spro na gtor chog phyag len ltar dang*/ mdor bsdu na/ gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ sa byin gyis rlabs la/ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ hūm̐/ 'og min bde chen dag pa'i pho brang nas// rnam snang thugs las sprul pa'i mthu bo che// bstan srung kun gyi gtso bo rdo rje gur// dpal ldan mgon po 'dir byon mchod gtor bzhes// yongs 'du'i tshal dang gshin rje'i pho brang dang*// 'dzam gling de wī ko ṭā'i gnas mchog nas// 'dod khams gtso mo nam gru re ma ti// dpal ldan lha mo 'dir gshegs mchod gtor bzhes// snang srid bha ga dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor nas// 'khor 'das kun gyi bdag mo dbyings phyug yum// sngags srung drag mo ma mo mkha' 'gro'i gtso// yum chen ral gcig 'dir byon mchod gtor bzhes// bsil ba'i tshal dang ha ha dgod pa dang*// siṅga gling dang ti se gangs ri dang*// dar lung gnas dang kha'u'i brag rdzong nas// zhing skyong dbang po 'dir byon mchod gtor bzhes// dur khrod brgyad dang lho phyogs ri sul dang*// rdo rje gdan dang dpal gyi bsam yas dang*// na la rtse dang dpal ldan sa skya nas// las mgon pho mo 'dir byon mchod gtor bzhes// byang shar ma ru rtse yi dur khrod dang*// rgya gar bang so dmar po'i brag ri dang*// dar lung brag hram la sogs gnas mchog nas// gnod sbyin lcam bral 'dir byon mchod gtor bzhes// gsol lo mchod do rgyal ba'i bstan srung tshogs// bsgrub bo brtan no bla ma'i bka' srung che// 'bod do bskul lo rnal 'byor dgra lha'i tshogs// rings pa'i tshul gyis 'dir byon mchod gtor bzhes// sha khrag dmar gyis brgyan pa'i gtor mas mchod// dza gad sman phud rakta'i btung bas mchod// rnga chen rkang gling rol mo'i sgra yis mchod// dar nag 'phan chen sprin ltar gtibs pas mchod// yid 'phrog spyan gzigs nam mkha' mnyam pas mchod// rab brjid snyan pa'i dbyangs kyi nga ros mchod// phyi nang gsang ba'i dam rdzas rgya mtshos mchod// bde stong dbyer med ye shes rol pas mchod// sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyen po khyod kyis srungs// dkon mchog dbu 'phang gnyen po khyed kyis bstod// dpal ldan bla ma'i phrin las khyed kyis spel// rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las khyod kyis sgrubs//

bstod bskul 'di yang rdo rje 'chang blo gsal rgya mtshos mdzad pa'o// ༈ /mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i dur khrod bdag po la gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ gtor ma/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ sa byin gyis rlabs la/ mdun gyi nam mkhar hūm̐ yig las e chad pas nam mkhar rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ ra las rakta'i rgya mtsho/ suṃ las zhing chen gyi sa gzhi/ keṃ las keng rus kyi ri rab/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ sum̐ las thod mkhar gyi gzhal yas khang mi mgo skam po las grub pa'i gru bzhi pa/ mi rus kyi rkang dang*/ rtsib rus sna tshogs kyis steng thog phub pa/ thod skam gyi mda' yab dang pu shus brgyan cing*/ rgyu rlon gyi drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang pa/ 'og tu rus pa dang sha khrag sna tshogs kyis gcal du bkram pa/ de'i steng du paṃ padma maṇḍal hūm̐ gis padma'i gdan/ ma sūrya maṇḍal la hūm̐ gis nyi ma'i gdan/ a tsand+ra maṇḍal la hūm̐ gis zla ba'i gdan gnyis su gyur/ gdan gyi steng du sa bon hūm̐ dang am̐ las dung dang mgron bu hūm̐ dang am̐ gis mtshan pa las dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum gnyis sku mdog dkar zhing 'od zer 'phro ba keng rus shin tu 'jigs pa'i gzugs can zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ spyan bgrad cing ljags 'dril ba/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas kyis thod skam gyi dbyug pa nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar bsnams zhing zhal du gsol ba/ zhabs g.yas bskums pas g.yon pa'i brla la brten pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs dang*/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan dang snyan chas brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i yab yum la 'khor 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pas bskor bar gyur/ de gnyis kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/

thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas dang*/ o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i yul nas dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum la 'khor 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ hūm̐/ dpal ldan mthu stobs dbang phyug che// phrin las rnam bzhi'i don mdzad pa// dad ldan dam tshig chen po yi// gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol// shrī shma sha na a dhi pa ti ye e hye hi/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ padma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ/ ces dang*/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ sogs nas/ shabda āḥhūm̐ gis phyi mchod/ dza hūm̐ḥbaṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs kyis dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'khor lo sdom pa lhan cig skyes pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ nas/ shabda āḥhūm̐/ rgyal ba'i thugs kyi phrin las kun// ma lus gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir// 'jigs pa'i skur ston 'dod don ster// dur khrod gnas kyi bdag por bstod// ces pas bstod/ oṃ badzra sa ma ya st+waṃ/ sa ma ya hoḥ dpal ldan dur khrod kyi bdag po 'khor dang bcas pas mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs rnams dang*/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ sems can thams cad la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i gdon bgegs log 'dren thams cad tshar gcod pa dang*/ tshe ring nad med longs spyod 'phel zhing chom rkun thams cad bcing ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes pas phrin las bcol/ ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma gsol bar bsams la/ oṃ ghṛ rā dza ghṛ rā dza ku ma ku ma khuṃ this swā hā/ shrī shma shā na a dhi pa ti ma hā pi shā tsi ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa gsum mam mdun gyis phul bas gsol te dgyes par bsams la/

oṃ badzra arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ nas shabda āḥhūm̐ gis mchod/ nang mchod gtor zhing*/ oṃ ghṛ rā dza ghṛ rā dza ku ma ku ma khuṃ this swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po 'khor dang bcas pas mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs rnams dang*/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ sems can thams cad la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i gdon bgegs log 'dren rnams tshar gcod pa dang*/ tshe ring nad med longs spyod 'phel zhing chom rkun thams cad bcing ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ ces phrin las bcol/ hūm̐/ rgyal ba'i thugs kyi phrin las kun// ma lus gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir// 'jigs pa'i skur ston 'dod don ster// dur khrod gnas kyi bdag por bstod// rnam dkar keng rus dag pa'i gzugs// phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med par// gang la ci 'dod dngos grub kun// nye bar stsol mdzad khyod la bstod// yang dag lam la nyer gnas te// lus can bde la bkod mdzad pa'i// srid pa'i 'ching ba kun las skyob// phan bde kun stsol khyod la bstod// gang gis khyed sgrub khyed mchod na// dam bcas bzhin du nyer dgongs nas// ji ltar gsol ba btab pa bzhin// bdag la dngos grub ma lus stsol// mchod sbyin gtor ma rgya mtsho dang*// dngos grub kun 'byung dam rdzas kyis// dpal ldan bstan srung 'khor bcas mchod// phrin las gang bcol 'grub par mdzod// ces pas bstod/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum gyis gtor ma byin gyis rlabs la/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral par bcas la/ phai/ཾ oṃ badzra ā ralli hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥbadzra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya st+waṃ dṛ shya hoḥ zhes gtor mgron spyan drangs la gtor ma phul bar bsams te/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'i mthar se gol gtogs shing*/

oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba yakṣa rākṣa sa bhū ta pre ta pi shā tsi unma da/ a pa smā ra/ ḍā ka ḍā kī n+yā da ya/ i maṃ ba liṃ gṛhṇantu sa ma ya ra kṣantu/ ma ma sarba siddhimme pra yatstshantu/ ya thai bam̐/ ya the ṣṭaṃ/ bhuhadza tha/ dzi gha tha/ pi pa tha/ ma ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kārya/ sat+su khaṃ bi shu ddha ye/ sa hā yi kā bha wantu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul/ oṃ arghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ pā dyaṃ swā hā/ sogs nas/ shabda āḥhūm̐/ zhes phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul la/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rin chen mkha' 'gro/ padma mkha' 'gro/ sna tshogs mkha' 'gro la sogs pa gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i sku tshe srings/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba dang*/ bsam sbyor chos mthun yid bzhin du 'grub pa dang*/ byang chub ma thob kyi bar du srung skyob sba ba'i phrin las sdong grogs rgya chen po mdzad du gsol// ༈ / gzhi bdag gtor ma ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ sa byin gyis rlabs/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ bhū mi pa ti ā karṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs la mgron 'gugs/ oṃ ā kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇāṃ adya nutpanna twad oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ nas shabda āḥhūm̐/ zhes phyi mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid sa'i lha mo brtan ma/ bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis la sogs pa'i gnas bdag

gzhi bdag grong bdag yul bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams dang*/ ma ltar byams shing sring ltar nye ba rnams la 'bul lo// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba dang*/ gnas mgron gyi dam tshig srungs/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bya ba dang spyod pa nyes pa la ko long ru nga phrag dog ma mdzad par bsam sbyor chos mthun yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i phrin las sdong grogs rgya chen po mdzad du gsol/ na mo bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dag dang*// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang*// chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis// don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun// de dag thams cad ci rigs pa// 'jig rten khams 'dir ma lus par// thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig / ces brjod// ༈ /de nas tshogs mchod ni/ tshogs kyi yo byad ci 'byor pa dang*/ khyad par thod pa'i snod du ma da na zhes chang dang*/ bā la zhes sha rnams bkod pa mdzes par bshams pa'i tshogs rdzas rnams nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs/ tshogs pa mang po yod na las kyi rdo rjes phyag gsum btsal nas/ tshogs kyi yo byad la byin rlabs gnang bar zhu/ zhes brjod/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor la/ oṃ sumbha ni sumbha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhṇa zhes sogs nas/ bidyā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa zhes pas bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa zhes pas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por 'gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan mang du brjod pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho zad mi shes par gyur bar bsam pa ni shin tu gal che bas dmigs pa ma yengs par bya/ de nas tshogs kyi phud snod gnyis su blugs pa dang*/ med na snod gcig tu blugs la dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du phul/

spro na/ gtor ma rnams la'ang phud thams cad nas ma lus par phul/ slar yang thams cad la nang mchod chu chang gis bran/ las kyi rdo rjes phyag gsum btsal la/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gi drung du sman phud 'bul bar zhu/ zhes brjod/ slob dpon rnams kyis/ dman pa'i yul las rab 'das shing*// rgyal ba kun gyi dam tshig mchog /dngos grub kun gyi gzhir gyur pa// bdud rtsi mchog gis mchod par bgyi// sgrib pa'i dri ma kun bsal nas// rtog pa kun las rnam grol ba// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// bde ba chen pos mnyes gyur cig / ces brjod/ yang phyag gsum btsal la/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gi drung du tshogs phud 'bul bar zhu/ zhes brjod/ slob dpon rnams kyis/ zhal zas ro brgya ldan pa'i yid 'phrog pa// legs sbyar 'di ni rgyal ba sras bcas la// dad pas phul bas 'gro ba 'di dag kun// 'byor ldan ting 'dzin zas la spyod par shog / ces brjod/ yang phyag gsum btsal/ mkha' 'gro dang chos skyong gi drung du tshogs phud 'bul bar zhu/ zhes brjod/ dpon slob rnams kyis/ oṃ oṃ oṃ/ sarba buddhu ḍā ki nī sogs nas phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ a kā ro sogs nas hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ ces rje btsun ma la phul/ de nas gur mgon lcam dral sogs kyi gtor ma yod na so sor gtor sngags kyis rgyas par phul ba'am/ mdor bsdu na/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya sa pā ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes dang*/ oṃ shrī dharmā pā la tsa turmu kha sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ shrī re ma ti sogs/ zhes dang*/ oṃ ghṛ ra dza ghṛ ra dza ku ma ku ma khuṃ this swā hā/ shrī shma shā na a dhi pa ti ma hā pi shā ci ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi zhes mthar/ oṃ kha khā khā hi sogs nas phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ a kā ro sogs nas phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa rnams phyag rgya dang bcas pas phul/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/

oṃ badzra pā dyaṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes sogs nas/ shabda āḥhūm̐/ rnams kyis phyi mchod 'bul/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ drin chen rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs chos skyong ba'i srung ma gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen por 'byung ba dang*/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi zhing*/ mthun rkyen thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes phud kyis dkon mchog mchod/ de nas dam tshig bsnol ba'i phyir rdo rje slob dpon gyi drung du ma da na'i snod padma bhañdza dpral ba nang la bstan pa bzhag de'i steng du ba la cung zhig bzhag la las kyi rdo rjes phyag gsum btsal pad kor byas la/ rdo rje 'dzin sogs dgongs su gsol// bdag gi tshogs kyi khyad par 'di// dang ba'i sems kyis 'bul lags kyis// ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol// ces brjod/ dpon slob rnams kyis/ e ma zhi ba chen po kye// tshogs chen 'bar bas nyon mongs sreg /'di 'dra'i bde ba chen po ste// kun kyang a ho su kha che// a ho ma hā su kha hoḥ zhes brjod/ yang phyag gsum dang pad kor byas la/ 'di ni chos rnams bzang por ltos// 'dus pa la ni the tshom med// bram ze gdol pa khyi dang phag /rang bzhin gcig tu rol du gsol// ces pa'i lan du/ bde gshegs chos la rin thang med// 'dod chags la sogs dri ma bral// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam spangs pa// de bzhin nyid la gus phyag 'tshal// a hoḥm hā su kha hoḥ zhes brjod/ de nas las kyi rdo rjes lag pa gnyis padma'i phyag rgya las srin lag g.yas kyis steng gi ba la 'dzin pas rdo rje slob dpon nas rim bzhin ma da na 'grim tshar ba dang*/

tshogs kyi rdzas rnams ma tshang ba med pa slob dpon la nyis 'gyur sogs dpon slob thams cad la lag pa gnyis kas 'bul zhing len pa pos kyang lag pa gnyis kas pad kor gyis blang bar bya/ a hoḥm hā su kha hoḥ zhes brjod cing blang dgos te/ he badzra las/ padma'i lag pas blang ba dang*// de nyid kyis ni lag pas 'bul// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de nas thams cad la phul zin pa dang*/ sa rjen la mi 'jog cing slob dpon gyis/ thams cad tshogs la rol bar zhu/ zhes brjod// ༈ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyi mchod pa'i rdo rje'i glu bde chen rtag pa dam pa'i sprin gyi rol mo zhes bya ba// ༈ / 'od gsal rnam kun mchog ldan ye shes kyi rol mo// zung 'jug dngas ma'i gzugs skur mngon gsum du shar ba// dran pas snying gi gdung sel dpal ldan gyi bla mas// bde stong ye shes skye bar byin gyis rang rlobs shig /e dbyings shin tu rnam dag spros bral gyi gnas lugs// bam̐ yig bcu drug dga' ma'i mtshan dpe ru bzhengs pa'i// lhan skyes mkha' la spyod pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang mos// rlung sems dbu mar thim pa'i dngos grub zhig stsol dang*// yul chen nyi shu rtsa bzhir rang bzhin gyis snang ba'i// thabs shes phyag rgya'i gzugs 'chang dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro// zhing skyes pho nya'i tshogs kyi 'du ba la brtan nas// bde chen nyams brgyas sgeg pa'i skal bzang la sbyor zhig /stong nyid mkha' la bris pa'i ting 'dzin gyi nyams 'gyur// ngo mtshar dbang po'i gzhu bzhin sna tshogs su 'char ba'i// sngags skyes rdo rje btsun mo'i bsam gtan gyi dga' ma// cir snang bde chen 'dren pa'i skyo grogs la phebs dang*// rmad byung rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang gi mthar thug /rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i bdud rtsi'i dga' ston la spyod pas// brtan g.yo'i tshul du snang ba'i tha mal gyi dngos kun// he ru ka dpal 'grub pa'i smon lam zhig zhu'o//

zhes pa'ang 'jam mgon bla ma rin po che ngag gi dbang phyug byams pa phun tshogs dpal bzang pos 'di ltar bris zhes rdo rje'i bka' stsal spyi bor mchod de/ bya bral ba kun tu rgyu mañdzu gho ṣas gsol ba btab pa siddhi rastu// 'di dag gi skabs su snod dang mi ldan pa'i skye bos dben par byas la/ dpon slob thams cad kyis gtsang sme'i rnam rtog mi bya bar snying ga'i bam̐ yig sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor mchod ba'i bsam pas rdzas thams cad tshim par longs spyod/ khyad par dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa lta bu'i sdom pa 'og ma'i bcas pa bsrung ba'i bsam pas ma da na dang phyi dro'i kha zas spong sems kyis tshogs rdzas khyad du bsad na rtsa ltung du 'gyur te/ dam tshig rdzas ni ji bzhin rnyed// mi bsten pa ni bcu gsum pa// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// tshogs kyi dus thams cad du rtsod pa dang kha shag 'gyed pa sogs mi bya bar chos kyi gling brjod dang rdo rje'i glu gar la sogs pas dus 'da' bar bya'o// de yang tshogs kyi skabs su sha la ba la dang*/ chang la ma da na la sogs pa'i brda skad bya dgos te/ he badzra gyi rgyud las/ gal te sangs rgyas gsang ba'i skad// mi gsung na ni 'grongs par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ gsang ba'i skad kyis mi smra bar// de yi dam tshig nyams par ni// 'gyur ba 'di la the tshom med// ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ de nas thams cad kyis tshims par longs spyod pa'i rjes su// ༈ /las kyi rdo rjes snod gcig tu mas rim gyi tshogs lhag bsdus la/ mtshan mo yin na grib gnon gyi gdon bsrung ba'i phyir dpal 'bar dang bcas rdo rje slob dpon gyi mdun du stegs kyi steng du bzhag chu gtsang dang slob dpon gyis chang gi kha phru 'bar ba'i phyag rgya'i bar nas gtor zhing*/ oṃ aḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor byin gyis brlabs la/ phaiṃ/ zhes dang*/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi u tstshiṣṭa ba liṃ ta bhakṣa si swā hā/

zhes lan gsum brjod/ 'byung po lhag ma la dbang ba rnams la sbyin no// ngoms shing tshim pa'i skal pa dang ldan par gyur cig ces phyi rol du dor/ ḍā dril dang rol mo'i sgra cher bya zhing*/ bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las legs byung ba'i// he ru ka dpal 'jigs byed rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku// shes rab phag mo'i padmar rdo rjes rol mdzad pa'i// bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par/ gang gi lam gyis grol 'gyur ba// des ni sangs rgyas nyid 'thob shog / ces pas bkra shis smon lam bya/ tshogs mchod 'di la phyag len rgyas bsdus sna tshogs yod kyang rmor chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa 'dis don tshang zhing 'jug bde bar yod/ gong gi zhu 'bul rnams ma byas kyang chad skyon med do// ༈ /rjes kyi cho ga ni/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos shing*/ oṃ sumbha ni sumbha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhṇa zhes sogs nas bidyā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa dngas shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra pā dyaṃ āḥhūm̐/ sogs nas/ shabda āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis rlabs la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra pā dyāṃ pra tītstsha zhes sogs nas shabda pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra ghaṇḍe ra ṇi ta zhes sogs āḥkhaṃ swā hā/ zhes rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod 'bul/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum brnyes// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya bar rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bdag dang sems can thams cad dag pa mkha' spyod du 'khrid par mdzad du gsol/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ oṃ badzra he ru ka sa ma ya zhes sogs nas sa twa āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod cing*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba// de kun mgon pos bzod par gsol// bdag cag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang bying ba dang rgod pa'i dbang du gyur pa thams cad dang cho ga lhag pa dang chad par gyur pa dang mchod pa'i yo byad ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang dkyil 'khor sgrub pa la skyon du gyur pa gang yin pa de dag thams cad bzod par gsol lo// zhes lhag chad kha bskong bar mdzad du gsol / phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu yang sku gzugs kyi rten 'di rnams la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams ji srid 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi mgon dang skyabs dang dpung gnyen dam pa mdzad du gsol/

oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzrā ye swā hā/ zhes brjod cing rten la me tog 'thor zhing brtan bzhugs bya/ maṇḍal gyi ye shes pa dang bum nang gi ye shes pa dang*/ rten med pa'i gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa rnams/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzod// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// badzra muḥ ye shes pa rang bzhin gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bdag nyid la gnyis su med par thim par gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros khams gsum thams cad khyab/ gzugs med khams 'od zer sngon po'i rnam pas lus kyi stod kyi cha la thim/ gzugs khams 'od zer dmar po'i rnam pas bar gyi cha la thim/ 'dod khams 'od zer dkar po'i rnam pas smad kyi cha la thim/ rang yang stod smad nas rim bzhin 'od du zhu nas chos 'byung la thim/ de zla ba la/ de sngags phreng la/ de bam̐ gyi mgo bo la/ de zla tshes la/ de thig le la/ de nā da la/ de je phra je phra mi dmigs par gyur/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur lam gyis gsal ba'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar ham̐ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇḍi kā'i ngo bor gyur/ ces brjod/ oṃ sumbha ni sumbha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhṇa zhes sogs nas/ bidyā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sngags tshar gnyis phyag rgya dang bcas pas phyogs g.yon bskor/ mtshams g.yas bskor gyis bsrung ba bya// ༈ /na mo badzra tsaṇḍa lī yi/ mkha' spyod zhal bzang lta ba'i smon lam bzhugs so// ༄// na mo badzra wā rā hyai/

mtha' yas rgyal ba'i bde stong zlos gar ni// srid zhi'i mig 'phrul cir yang snang ba las// deng 'dir mkha' spyod dpal mo yid 'ong ma// snying nas dran no 'khyud pa'i rtse dgas skyongs// 'og min gnas na lhan skyes rgyal yum ma// nyer bzhi'i yul na zhing skyes ḍā ki ma// nor 'dzin khyab par karma mu dra ma// rnal 'byor bdag gi skyabs mgon rje btsun ma// khyod ni sems nyid stong pa'i rang rtsal te// rdo rje'i grong na e dbyings bam̐ gyi dngos// sgyu ma'i gling na 'jigs rung srin mo dang*// 'dzum dkar g.yo ba'i lang tsho gsal bar ston// da ni bdag gis ji ltar btsal gyur kyang*// bden par grub pa'i nges pa ma rnyed nas// spros pas dub pa'i sems kyi skyes bu de// brjod bral nags kyi khang bur ngal gso bsten// e ma da ni ḍā ki dbyings nas bzhengs// he ru ka dpal rgyud kyi rgyal po las// rdo rje btsun mo'i nye ba'i snying po mchog /bklags pas 'grub ces gsung ba'i bden pas skyongs// o ḍī ya na'i bas mtha'i nags khrod du// grub pa'i dbang phyug rdo rje dril bu pa// 'khyud dang tsum pa'i bde bas rjes bskyong nas// mkha' spyod gnas su khrid bzhin bdag kyang skyongs// gaṅgā'i gling du rje btsun ku sā li// mngon sum nam mkha'i dbyings su khrid pa dang*// dpal ldan nā ro tā pa rje bzung ltar// bdag kyang mkha' spyod dga' ma'i grong du khrid// rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi thugs rje dang*// rgyud chen gsang mtha'i zab lam myur ched dang*// rnal 'byor bdag gi lhag bsam dag pa'i mthus// mkha' spyod dga' ma'i 'dzum zhal myur mthong shog / ces pa'ang thol byung du smras so// zhes tshar chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'o/ /lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*// des gsungs tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin pas// bden pa de dag gis ni bdag cag rnams// rtag tu rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig

/'chi tshe mgon dang dpa' bo ma tshogs kyis// me tog gdugs dang rgyal mtshan thogs nas su// rol mo glu dbyangs sgra snyan sogs mchod cing*// mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su 'khrid par shog / ces smon lam btab/ de nas bkra shis ni/ phun tshogs dge legs kun gyi dpal mnga' ba// rdo rje 'chang chen paṇa chen nā ro sogs// dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i tshogs rnams kyi// byin rlabs myur du 'jug pa'i bkra shis shog /rgyal ba'i yum mchog shes rab pha rol phyin// rang bzhin 'od gsal gdod nas spros dang bral// brtan g.yo'i dngos kun spro dang sdud mdzad ma// mkha' spyod chos kyi sku yi bkra shis shog /mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar rab mdzes brjid pa'i sku// drug cu'i dbyangs ldan theg mchog sgrogs pa'i gsung*// ye shes lnga ldan bde gsal mi rtog thugs// lhan skyes longs spyod rdzogs sku'i bkra shis shog /sna tshogs zhing du sna tshogs gzugs sku yis// sna tshogs thabs kyis sna tshogs gdul bya'i don// sna tshogs bsam pa ji bzhin sgrub mdzad ma// zhing skyes sprul pa'i sku yi bkra shis shog /padma rā ga'i mdog mtshungs rje btsun ma// 'dzum khro'i nyams ldan zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis// gri thod legs 'dzin zhabs zung brkyang bskum tshul// thugs skyes mkha' spyod mchog gi bkra shis shog /gang gi rnam 'phrul grangs med bye ba phrag /stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis tshogs rnams kyis// sgrub pa po yi bar chad kun sel zhing*// 'dod don dngos grub stsol ba'i bkra shis shog / ces chos rje byams pa chos legs pas mdzad pa'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa 'dis mtshon bkra shis rgyas par brjod do// de ltar rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi mngon dkyil las dang po rnams kyi tshes bcu sogs kyi skabs su nye bar mkho ba ngag 'don lag len nag po 'gro shes kyi tshul du bkod pa 'di ni/

rdo rje rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rtsa ba lta bu/ phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i dkyil chog rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa la gtso bor bsten/ 'phags pa rin po che'i bdag 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i gsung sgros/ chos rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang po'i sgrub dkyil las byung ba ltar/ bla ma'i gsung gi bdud rtsis kyang kha brgyan nas/ rje btsun rdo rje 'chang rdo rings kun spang ba chen po'i zhabs kyi padmo spyi bos mchod pa'i rnal 'byor pa blo gsal gyis 'o yug grub pa'i gnas kyi gtsug lag khang du bkod pa 'dis kyang bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig yi ge pa ni rje btsun bla ma dam pa nyid kyi dran du gyur pa'i btsun pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis bgyis pa'o/ /zhes pa'i sgrub dkyil la sogs khong rnams dang mchod phreng tshogs mchod sogs cho ga'i yan lag phra mo tshun las dang po pa'i gang zag sgrub pa la mos pa rnams tshig 'don bde ched dang*/ dpe mang du tshol ba dang*/ the tshom gyi ngal ba mi dgos shing phyag len go ba mi 'khrug pa'i ched du kha bskang*/ lhan thabs dkyus su bcug pa'i nag 'gros bklag chog gsal ba'i me long 'di dus gsum rgyal ba'i gsang gsum gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bo/ rmor chen chos kyi rgyal po rdo rje 'chang gi zhabs rdul spyi bos mchod pa'i bka' 'bangs lha rigs 'a zha'i rigs kyi rnal 'byor pa slob bshad 'dzin pa/ ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas kyis gtsang stod sman thang gi lcam yum blo gsal kun dga' chos kyi sgron ma'i gzigs dpe dang*/ gzhan yang lam 'dir dad brtson ldan pa rnams la phan pa'i blos 'dar bsam 'grub kyi gzim chung dga' ldan yang rtser dag par bsgrig pa'i yi ge pa ni rig pa 'dzin pa rnam rgyal 'gyur med kyis dad gus rtse gcig pa'i sgo nas legs par grub cing*/

rgyas par 'dod na dpe 'di'i stod du brgyud 'debs skabs/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i brgyud 'debs dang*/ mkha' spyod zhing bkod kyi gsol 'debs rje bla ma rmor chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa/ mdun bskyed bstod pa dkyus dang res mos byas na phan yon che zhing*/ tshogs pa mang na maṇḍal zhu 'bul rgyas pa dang*/ gtor bsngo'i dus mgon po che chung gi gtor bsngo bskang gso sogs rgyas pa byed 'dod na'ang bsnan chog cing gzhan ma gang yang bsnan mi dgos shing*/ bsdus pa bya 'dod na mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i nye lam nang gsal sor bzhag gis 'thus pas phyin chad 'di 'bri ba rnams kyi gong gsal de las gzhan pa'i 'bri bsnan dang*/ mgyogs khyad sla chos shes rloms ma mdzad cig dpe 'di zhing skyong dur khrod bdag po yab yum sha za mkha' 'gro ye shes kyi spyan ldan rnams la bcol lo// gnyer ro// gtad do// tshul bzhin sgrub pa rnams kyi tshe dpal bsod nams dbang phyug bskyed cing bsam don chos bzhin 'grub pa dang*/ mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub myur du 'grub pa'i sdong grogs g.yel med mdzad du gsol zhing*/ 'di dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par mdzad du gsol// i daṃ shā sa na sarba sa twa hi to bha wantu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
